title: Tap-driven mark with palette wipes
summary: A centered mark contracts like a press, then rebounds as a rounded field expands to the next palette color. Five evenly spaced changes and a matched loop make a compact, tactile brand intro.
use_when: A brand mark and a five-color palette are the whole story
A square silent loop needs an interaction-like rhythm
A short brand intro should feel tactile without showing a cursor

look.type_style: medium grotesk, uppercase, open tracking, about 3% of frame height; paired technical values align in two columns

sfx.event: mark releases and the next palette field takes over

structure.shot: opening palette state with a centered mark card and three small color-information lines
structure.camera: locked center; no camera travel; mark card changes scale 1.00 -> ~0.52 -> 1.00
structure.motion: card contracts with easings.inExpo over ~7 fr (±0.25 s); rounded field mask-wipe expands over 9 fr, mark rebounds with easings.outExpo 9 fr

structure.shot: second palette state holds, then the centered mark compresses to trigger the next color
structure.camera: locked center; no camera travel; mark card changes scale 1.00 -> ~0.52 -> 1.00
structure.motion: incoming field and mark settle with easings.outExpo ~5 fr; hold; card contracts ~8 fr (±0.25 s), next mask-wipe runs 10 fr

structure.shot: third palette state keeps the mark centered while the labels update, then another press changes color
structure.camera: locked center; no camera travel; mark card changes scale 1.00 -> ~0.52 -> 1.00
structure.motion: mark rebounds with easings.outExpo ~9 fr; hold; easings.inExpo contraction ~8 fr (±0.25 s), rounded mask-wipe 9 fr

structure.shot: neutral palette state holds the same mark and information layout before a centered color field grows
structure.camera: locked center; no camera travel; mark card changes scale 1.00 -> ~0.52 -> 1.00
structure.motion: mark rebounds with easings.outExpo ~9 fr; hold; easings.inExpo contraction ~8 fr, mask-wipe ~10 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: fifth palette state settles, holds the centered mark, then compresses into the return color
structure.camera: locked center; no camera travel; mark card changes scale 1.00 -> ~0.52 -> 1.00
structure.motion: mark rebounds with easings.outExpo ~9 fr; hold; easings.inExpo contraction ~8 fr (±0.25 s), rounded mask-wipe 10 fr

structure.shot: opening palette state returns with the same mark scale and information layout for a seamless loop
structure.camera: locked center; no camera travel; mark card settles at scale 1.00
structure.motion: incoming field completes over ~5 fr and mark settles with easings.outExpo ~9 fr (±0.25 s); final ~31 fr hold

params.brand: any brand.json; logo mark, fonts, card color, and demo palette all come from it
params.content.colors: six palette states: five steps plus a final state matching the first; each has color, label, detailLabel, and detailValue
params.tapFrames: five contraction start frames at 30 fps; defaults follow the measured transition windows and scale with fps
params.cardScale: contracted mark-card scale, about 0.52 in the reference
params.wipeFrames: five rounded-field expansion durations, 9-10 frames at 30 fps, scaled with fps
params.aspect: 1:1 by default; preserve the centered mark and corner labels when recomposing
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales from the measured 30 fps structure

notes: No hard cuts, beats, music, VO, or audible SFX. Four detector-confirmed soft windows are 0.53-0.83, 2.30-2.63, 4.33-4.63, and 8.30-8.63 s; the sheets show the same palette change around 6.50 s although it was not classified as soft. The final state matches the opening state. Sub-frame press timing and overshoot are only measurable to ±0.25 s. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms: tap-squash and palette-cycle.
